reasons.text: The serial number QQ75936211 does not start with "BN", so it is outside the recalled serial number range and the unit is not part of this recall.
Duplicate check found no other claims sharing a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account, so no flag applies.

The label is legible and shows the recalled model MK04, the date code is in range, and the purchase is inside the sale window from a listed retailer; these do not override the out-of-range serial number.
Under the claim policy, a serial number outside the recalled range results in denial.
